jGKYoFtOUgZ4gLWQpheXrA.zh: 全球自2022年截至今年5/31累計144國/地區報告18萬5,882例確定病例,其中509例死亡。 今年5月共計32國家/地區報告1,142例確定病例,其中3例死亡(CFR 0.3%),以馬達加斯加(649例)、中國(89例)、法國(63例)、澳洲(50例)及德國(45例)為高,63.9%的病例來自非洲地區。相較今年4月,西太平洋區及非洲區病例數呈上升趨勢 ,其餘地區疫情則下降,挪威通報首例Ib型病例,另波蘭先前的I型病例確定為Ib型次分支。 非洲地區近6週(5/4-6/14)共計10國報告790例確定病例,其中3 例死亡(CFR 0.45%),以馬達加斯加、肯亞、幾內亞、南蘇丹、喀麥隆及剛果⺠主共和國為高;非洲以外地區,為西班牙與泰國持續報告Ib型社區傳播。 馬達加斯加自2025年12月以來面臨全球最大規模的Ib型疫情,截至今年6/14,累計2,117例確定病例與7例死亡(多為免疫低下者)。疫情已擴及全國60%的行政區(69/115),主要影響15-49 歲族群。雖已推動MVA-BN疫苗接種(超過7.9萬人施打),惟面臨疫苗缺貨、冷鏈物流與醫療量能挑戰,疫情迄未受到控制。
jGKYoFtOUgZ4gLWQpheXrA.en: Globally, from 2022 through 31 May this year, 144 countries and territories have reported 185,882 confirmed cases, including 509 deaths. In May this year, 32 countries and territories reported 1,142 confirmed cases, including 3 deaths (CFR 0.3%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar (649), China (89), France (63), Australia (50) and Germany (45), and 63.9% of cases came from the African Region. Compared with April this year, case numbers rose in the Western Pacific and African Regions and declined in other regions. Norway reported its first clade Ib case, and Poland's earlier clade I case has been identified as a clade Ib sub-lineage. In the African Region, over the past 6 weeks (4 May–14 June), 10 countries reported 790 confirmed cases, including 3 deaths (CFR 0.45%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar, Kenya, Guinea, South Sudan, Cameroon and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Outside Africa, Spain and Thailand continued to report clade Ib community transmission. Madagascar has faced the world's largest clade Ib outbreak since December 2025. As of 14 June this year, 2,117 confirmed cases and 7 deaths (mostly among immunocompromised people) have been reported cumulatively. The outbreak has spread to 60% of the country's administrative areas (69 of 115), mainly affecting people aged 15 to 49 years. Although MVA-BN vaccination has been rolled out (more than 79,000 people vaccinated), the outbreak remains uncontrolled because of challenges including vaccine shortages, cold chain logistics and health system capacity.

BcII_g5uTYjBw54Y2yxh4A.zh: 挪威5/26-6/15報告15例病例,病患年齡中位數29歲並以女性為多,檢測為Yersinia enterocolitica O3血清型且基因型都相同,當局推測為相同感染源,疫情調查進行中。另該國2025年報告94例病例。
BcII_g5uTYjBw54Y2yxh4A.en: Norway reported 15 cases between 26 May and 15 June. The median age of patients is 29 years, and most are women. Testing identified the Yersinia enterocolitica O3 serotype, with identical genotypes, and authorities suspect a common source of infection. The outbreak investigation is ongoing. Norway reported 94 cases in 2025.

1BlGexCO1199WOmqkA63fw.en: Update. Human cases: this year, 5 H5N1, 12 H9N2 and 1 H10N3 human influenza cases have been reported cumulatively. Most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Animal and avian outbreaks (WAHIS): 56 countries and territories have reported 3,303 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks this year. Fifteen countries reported 439 H5N1 outbreaks between 11 March and 30 April 2026: Germany 361, Chile 18, South Korea 14, Poland 13, Nepal 7, France 5, the United States and Taiwan four each, Canada 3, Denmark, Austria, Norway and the Netherlands two each, and Cambodia and Italy one each. South Korea reported four H5N9 outbreaks on 29 April 2026. US dairy cattle avian influenza has accounted for 1,093 outbreaks reported across 20 states since March 2024, with recent activity concentrated in Idaho, Wisconsin and California. US wastewater monitoring provided results for 425 sampling sites during 19–25 April 2026, of which 11 sites in New Jersey, Illinois, Maryland and Massachusetts detected H5-positive results.

UBnwJRPSP3Da6QWXWmad4w.en: Summary for the week. Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): three countries reported 16 H5N1 outbreaks during 25–29 August 2025, including Spain (10), and Bulgaria and Norway (3 each). Two countries reported two H5 (N-untyped) outbreaks during 25–29 August 2025, Norway and France (1 each). Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: 1,078 herd outbreaks have been reported across 17 states since March last year, recently concentrated mainly in California. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,600 monitored, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, among others, including a cat death. Wastewater monitoring: in week 34, 431 sampling sites provided results; two sampling sites in one state (Oregon) detected H5-positive samples. Annual summary. Human cases: H5N1 influenza, 27 cases (990 cumulatively since 2003); H9N2 influenza, 18 cases (146 cumulatively); H10N3 influenza, 2 cases (6 cumulatively); most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Avian and animal cases: 57 countries and regions have cumulatively reported 2,204 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks. Assessment and recommendations: On 28 July, FAO, WHO and WOAH completed a risk assessment of H5 viruses. H5 viruses (clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b, among others) remain avian viruses. Human cases were mostly associated with direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and the viruses have no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the viruses are widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and global public health risk is assessed as remaining low. Infection risk for the general public remains low; for people who often contact contaminated animals or environments, it is low to moderate. The main determinants are the mode of contact, duration, protective measures and control measures. Authorities call for enhanced surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoidance of drinking unpasteurized dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sector response.

Iua_NyibxXZ9vvR-SvrZxA.zh: 法國自6月截至8/13累積報告18例病例,其中2例死亡,病患年齡介於34-95歲間,比利時、丹麥、荷蘭、挪威亦檢出相關案例;當局已下架疑感染源(牛/羊奶起司),惟該產品已銷往全球32個國家/地區,包含鄰近之香港、日本及韓國。
Iua_NyibxXZ9vvR-SvrZxA.en: France has reported 18 cases since June, as of 13 August, of which 2 died; patients are aged 34–95 years. Related cases have also been detected in Belgium, Denmark, the Netherlands and Norway. Authorities have withdrawn the suspected source, a cheese made from cow's and sheep's milk, but the product has been sold to 32 countries and regions, including neighbouring Hong Kong, Japan and South Korea.

NPNOR9-wt3cigiaStI8Dow.zh: 挪威首都奧斯陸某餐廳爆發群聚疫情,累計報告22例病例,病患於7月後發病,病毒型別為IA;該餐廳在感染風險期間(6月中旬至8月)累計服務1.5萬名顧客,該餐廳已停止營業,衛生當局並提供顧客接種疫苗。
NPNOR9-wt3cigiaStI8Dow.en: A cluster outbreak occurred at a restaurant in Oslo, the capital of Norway. A total of 22 cases have been cumulatively reported; patients fell ill after July, and the virus type is IA. During the period of infection risk (mid-June to August), the restaurant served a cumulative total of 15,000 customers. The restaurant has ceased operations, and health authorities have offered vaccination to customers.

T5o1icBBPBJGiEF_BfKr8A.en: Summary for this week: Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): a total of 8 countries reported 52 new H5N1 outbreaks between 17 February and 28 April 2025: the United States 17, South Korea 12, the United Kingdom 11, Germany and Poland 4 each, Hungary 2, and Bangladesh and Denmark 1 each. A total of 2 countries reported 2 new H5N5 outbreaks between 17 March and 11 April 2025: Norway and the United Kingdom 1 each. Japan reported 1 new H3N8 outbreak on 25 April 2025. Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: Herds: since March last year, 1,048 (17) outbreaks have been reported cumulatively across 17 states, with recent cases concentrated in Idaho, California and Arizona. Human infection via cattle: at least 9,300 cases have been monitored cumulatively, 218 tested, of which 41 were positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 17, 407 sampling sites provided test reports, and 5 sampling sites in 3 states (California, Oregon and New Jersey) detected H5-positive results. Other updates: on 2 May the US CDC updated its Influenza Risk Assessment Tool (IRAT), adding two new H5N1 viruses to the assessment list: A/California/147/2024 (genotype B3.13) and A/Washington/239/2024 (genotype D1.1). Both viruses belong to the H5N1 2.3.4.4b clade and were rated as moderate risk, close to other H5N1 viruses previously assessed. A journal commentary published on 28 April by experts from more than 40 countries called on countries to strengthen surveillance, enhance biosecurity and improve preparedness for emerging infectious diseases in response to the H5N1 threat. Since 2024 the US has reported more than 995 dairy herd outbreaks and at least 70 human cases, including several severe cases and the country's first death; some human cases had no contact with infected animals, suggesting the virus may be adapting and may have the potential for human-to-human transmission. The virus also continues to spread among wild birds, poultry and hunted migratory birds, increasing risks to humans and livestock. Continued investment in human and animal surveillance resources, and timely sharing of local abnormal information and viral genetic data, are essential for understanding virus dynamics. Annual summary: Human cases: 10 H5N1 influenza cases (973* cumulative since 2003) and 3 H9N2 influenza cases (131 cumulative); most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. (Following WHO counting methods, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 influenza cases.) Avian and animal cases: 1,656 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks have been reported cumulatively by 51 countries and regions. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 17 April. Currently, H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; most human cases had direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and no human-to-human transmission has occurred. Because the virus is widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. For infection risk, the risk is low for the general public and low to moderate for people who frequently contact contaminated animals or environments; the main factors are the mode and duration of contact, protective measures and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

9dUqwQz0qMZhfsXnTD1sGg.zh: 歐洲3/6報告,自2023/1-2025/1期間,累計9個國家/區509例病,分別為挪威(257例)、瑞典(110)、芬蘭(94)、德國(30)、荷蘭(9)、丹麥(4)、法國(3)、比利時(1)、愛沙亞(1)。多國調查皆認為感染源為義大利某產地之苜蓿芽,基因定序亦有相同結論,當局已實施相關介入措施,以防止受汙染產品進入市場。
9dUqwQz0qMZhfsXnTD1sGg.en: Europe reported on 6 March that, between January 2023 and January 2025, 509 cases had been reported cumulatively in 9 countries: Norway 257, Sweden 110, Finland 94, Germany 30, the Netherlands 9, Denmark 4, France 3, Belgium 1 and Estonia 1. Investigations in several countries concluded that the source was alfalfa sprouts from a production site in Italy, and genetic sequencing reached the same conclusion. Authorities have implemented relevant interventions to prevent contaminated products from entering the market.

CM2phWo-72KOhzycklMfag.zh: 挪威疫情持續,自10月中旬迄今累計報告49例,其中24例住院,病例遍及全國,經檢驗42例感染新港沙門氏菌(Salmonella Newport)及7例鼠傷寒桿菌(Salmonella typhimurium),調查顯示可能的感染源為苜蓿芽。另瑞典亦刻正爆發來自同一來源的苜蓿芽產品衍生的鼠傷寒桿菌感染疫情。
CM2phWo-72KOhzycklMfag.en: Norway's outbreak continues: since mid-October, 49 cases have been reported cumulatively, 24 of whom were hospitalised, with cases across the country. Testing found that 42 cases were infected with Salmonella Newport and 7 with Salmonella Typhimurium. Investigation indicates that the likely source of infection is alfalfa sprouts. Sweden is also experiencing an outbreak of Salmonella Typhimurium infection linked to alfalfa sprout products from the same source.
